description:
Cast Mirror Image by paying {2}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Swift Warkite.
When Mirror Image enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Mirror Image, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Mirror Image trigger, returning Mirror Image from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Swift Warkite.
Repeat from step 2.
